IS 1056 : 2025 Commercial Weights - Specification
ICS 01.060
ICS 01.060
PGD 26
PGD 26
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements of the following categories of solid and sheet metal weights intended for use in normal commercial transactions:
a) Iron weights, hexagonal (50 kg to 50 g);
b) Brass and bronze weights (10 kg to 1 g); and
c) Sheet metal weights (500 mg to 1 mg).
1.2 It does not cover proportional weights that are used, for instance, in certain types of weighing machines, weigh-bridges, etc.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
